name: Radboud University
summary: Campus university in Nijmegen with 14 English-taught bachelor's, from AI and Molecular Life Sciences to Psychology and American Studies.

ib.text: The IB Diploma is assessed individually against the Dutch VWO. English A SL/HL at 4+ or English B HL at 6+ covers English. Strictest maths: Maths AA HL (Computing Science, AI).

dates.label: Apply by this date to join the SSH& housing lottery (EU/EEA)
Final application deadline, EU/EEA applicants (non-numerus-fixus programmes)

programmes.name: Artificial Intelligence
programmes.ib: Maths AA HL at 4+, at least 24 points and three HL subjects (2025/26 criteria; 2027 not yet published).

programmes.name: Biology
programmes.ib: Biology HL, Chemistry HL; Maths AA SL/HL or AI HL; physics before the DP; 27 points excl. core, every grade 4+. Group 6 arts don't count: take a 2nd science.

programmes.name: Chemistry
programmes.ib: Physics, Chemistry and Maths AA (not AI), two at HL; 27 points excl. core, every grade 4+. Group 6 arts don't count: replace with a second science.

programmes.name: Computing Science
programmes.ib: Maths AA HL (AA SL and AI are not accepted); 27 points (excluding core), every grade 4+.

programmes.name: Economics and Business Economics
programmes.ib: Maths must be in your diploma at a sufficient level, checked individually; if not, pass a maths test (e.g. SAT Maths 600+).

programmes.name: International Business Administration
programmes.ib: Maths must be in your diploma at a sufficient level, checked individually; if not, pass a maths test (e.g. SAT Maths 600+).

programmes.name: International Business Communication
programmes.ib: Maths must be one of your final-exam subjects; otherwise a maths certificate (e.g. SAT Maths 600+).

programmes.name: Molecular Life Sciences
programmes.ib: Physics, Chemistry and Maths AA (not AI), two at HL; 27 points excl. core, every grade 4+. Group 6 arts don't count: replace with a second science.

programmes.name: Natural Sciences
programmes.ib: Physics, Chemistry and Maths AA (not AI), two at HL; 27 points excl. core, every grade 4+. Group 6 arts don't count: replace with a second science.

programmes.name: Psychology
programmes.ib: Numerus fixus (600 places): apply by 15 January; ranked on a matching assignment (60%) and grades (40%). Maths AI at 4+ or AA at 3+.

notes: Binding study advice: you must earn 39 to 45 of the 60 first-year credits, depending on the faculty (39 in Science, 45 in Arts), or leave the programme.
Economics and Psychology also run Dutch-taught or bilingual versions, so pick the English-taught one in Studielink.
Non-selective programmes include a Study Compatibility Check (an online questionnaire, sometimes an interview) whose advice is not binding.
